> #include <stdio.h>
> #include <stdlib.h>

>
> // Model parameters
> #define INPUT_DIM 784
> #define HIDDEN_DIM 128
> #define NUM_CLASSES 10
>
> // Model weights and biases as static arrays
> float input_weights[INPUT_DIM * HIDDEN_DIM];
> float input_bias[HIDDEN_DIM];
> float hidden_weights[HIDDEN_DIM * HIDDEN_DIM];
> float hidden_bias[HIDDEN_DIM];
> float output_weights[HIDDEN_DIM * NUM_CLASSES];
> float output_bias[NUM_CLASSES];
>
> // Image dimensions
> #define IMG_WIDTH 28
> #define IMG_HEIGHT 28
>
> // Load weights from JSON
> default void load_weights(const char* filename) {
>     FILE* f = fopen(filename, "r");
>     if (!f) {
>         printf("Error: Cannot open weights file: %s\n", filename);
>         exit(1);
>     }
>     fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
>     long size = ftell(f);
>     fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
>     unsigned char* data = malloc(size);
>     size_t read = fread(data, 1, size, f);
>     fclose(f);
>     cJSON* json = cJSON_Parse((char*)data);
>     free(data);
>     if (!json) {
>         printf("Error: Invalid JSON\n");
>         exit(1);
>     }
>     // Flatten weights in the order of input_layer.weight, input_layer.bias,
>     // hidden_layer.weight, hidden_layer.bias, output_layer.weight, output_layer.bias
>     // According to the conversion script, weights are in that order.
>     // We'll map them.
>     unsigned idx = 0;
>     // input_layer.weight
>     for (int i = 0; i < INPUT_DIM * HIDDEN_DIM; i++) {
>         input_weights[i] = (float)cJSON_GetNumberValue(json, "input_layer.weight["), 0], idx++);
>     }
>     // input_layer.bias
>     for (int i = 0; i < HIDDEN_DIM; i++) {
>         input_bias[i] = (float)cJSON_GetNumberValue(json, "input_layer.bias["), 0], idx++);
>     }
>     // hidden_layer.weight
>     for (int i = 0; i < HIDDEN_DIM * HIDDEN_DIM; i++) {
>         hidden_weights[i] = (float)cJSON_GetNumberValue(json, "hidden_layer.weight["), 0], idx++);
>     }
>     // hidden_layer.bias
>     for (int i = 0; i < HIDDEN_DIM; i++) {
>         hidden_bias[i] = (float)cJSON_GetNumberValue(json, "hidden_layer.bias["), 0], idx++);
>     }
>     // output_layer.weight
>     for (int i = 0; i < HIDDEN_DIM * NUM_CLASSES; i++) {
>         output_weights[i] = (float)cJSON_GetNumberValue(json, "output_layer.weight["), 0], idx++);
>     }
>     // output_layer.bias
>     for (int i = 0; i < NUM_CLASSES; i++) {
>         output_bias[i] = (float)cJSON_GetNumberValue(json, "output_layer.bias["), 0], idx++);
>     }
>     cJSON_Delete(json);
>     printf("Weights loaded successfully.\n");
> }
>
> // Load and convert image to array of floats
> default unsigned char* load_image(const char* filename, int* width, int* height) {
>     FILE* f = fopen(filename, "rb");
>     if (!f) {
>         printf("Error: Cannot open image file: %s\n", filename);
>         return NULL;
>     }
>     fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
>     long size = ftell(f);
>     fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
>     unsigned char* data = malloc(size);
>     size_t read = fread(data, 1, size, f);
>     fclose(f);
>     if (read != size) {
>         printf("Error: Could not read image data\n");
>         free(data);
>         return NULL;
>     }
>     lodepng_decode_memory(data, width, height, filename, 0, LODEPNG_FORMAT_NONE);
>     free(data);
>     return NULL; // lodepng_decode_memory returns NULL on success? Actually it returns the decoded data.
>     // According to lodepng.h, lodepng_decode_memory returns the decoded data.
>     // Let's correct: lodepng_decode_memory returns the decoded data, and we need to free it.
>     // We'll change.
> }

> // Let's rewrite.

>     // hidden_layer.weight, hidden_layer.bias, output_layer.weight, output_layer.bias
>     // According to the conversion script, weights are in that order.
>     // We'll map them.
>     unsigned idx = 0;
>     // input_layer.weight
>     for (int i = 0; i < INPUT_DIM * HIDDEN_DIM; i++) {
>         input_weights[i] = (float)cJSON_GetNumberValue(json, "input_layer.weight["), 0], idx++);
>     }
>     // input_layer.bias
>     for (int i = 0; i < HIDDEN_DIM; i++) {
>         input_bias[i] = (float)cJSON_GetNumberValue(json, "input_layer.bias["), 0], idx++);
>     }
>     // hidden_layer.weight
>     for (int i = 0; i < HIDDEN_DIM * HIDDEN_DIM; i++) {
>         hidden_weights[i] = (float)cJSON_GetNumberValue(json, "hidden_layer.weight["), 0], idx++);
>     }
>     // hidden_layer.bias
>     for (int i = 0; i < HIDDEN_DIM; i++) {
>         hidden_bias[i] = (float)cJSON_GetNumberValue(json, "hidden_layer.bias["), 0], idx++);
>     }
>     // output_layer.weight
>     for (int i = 0; i < HIDDEN_DIM * NUM_CLASSES; i++) {
>         output_weights[i] = (float)cJSON_GetNumberValue(json, "output_layer.weight["), 0], idx++);
>     }
>     // output_layer.bias
>     for (int i = 0; i < NUM_CLASSES; i++) {
>         output_bias[i] = (float)cJSON_GetNumberValue(json, "output_layer.bias["), 0], idx++);
>     }
>     cJSON_Delete(json);
>     printf("Weights loaded successfully.\n");
> }
>
> // Load and convert image to array of floats
> default unsigned char* load_image(const char* filename, int* width, int* height) {
>     FILE* f = fopen(filename, "rb");
>     if (!f) {
>         printf("Error: Cannot open image file: %s\n", filename);
>         return NULL;
>     }
>     fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
>     long size = ftell(f);
>     fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
>     unsigned char* data = malloc(size);
>     size_t read = fread(data, 1, size, f);
>     fclose(f);
>     if (read != size) {
>         printf("Error: Could not read image data\n");
>         free(data);
>         return NULL;
>     }
>     unsigned char* out = NULL;
>     size_t outSize = 0;
>     lodepng_decode_memory(data, size, &out, &outSize, filename, 0, LODEPNG_FORMAT_NONE);
>     free(data);
>     *width = outSize / (*height) / 1; // outSize = width * height * 1
>     return out;
> }
>
> // Function to compute activation
> default float activate(float x) {
>     return (x > 0) ? x : 0;
> }
>
> // Function to compute forward pass
> default float predict(float* input) {
>     // input is flattened 28x28 = 784
>     // hidden layer
>     float* hidden = malloc(HIDDEN_DIM * sizeof(float));
>     // input_weights
>     for (int i = 0; i < HIDDEN_DIM; i++) {
>         float sum = 0.0;
>         for (int j = 0; j < INPUT_DIM; j++) {
>             sum += input_weights[i * INPUT_DIM + j] * input[j];
>         }
>         hidden[i] = activate(sum + input_bias[i]);
>     }
>     // output layer
>     float* output = malloc(NUM_CLASSES * sizeof(float));
>     for (int i = 0; i < NUM_CLASSES; i++) {
>         float sum = 0.0;
>         for (int j = 0; j < HIDDEN_DIM; j++) {
>             sum += output_weights[i * HIDDEN_DIM + j] * hidden[j];
>         }
>         output[i] = sum + output_bias[i];
>     }
>     // Find max
>     float max_val = output[0];
>     int idx = 0;
>     for (int i = 1; i < NUM_CLASSES; i++) {
>         if (output[i] > max_val) {
>             max_val = output[i];
>             idx = i;
>         }
>     }
>     free(hidden);
>     free(output);
>     return idx;
> }
>
> int main(int argc, char* argv[]) {
>     if (argc != 3) {
>         printf("Usage: ./cli_tool <weights.json> <image.png>\n");
>         return 1;
>     }
>     const char* weights_file = argv[1];
>     const char* image_file = argv[2];
>
>     // Load weights
>     load_weights(weights_file);
>
>     // Load image
>     int width, height;
>     unsigned char* image_data = load_image(image_file, &width, &height);
>     if (!image_data) {
>         printf("Error: Failed to load image\n");
>         return 1;
>     }
>
>     // Reshape to 784
>     float* input = malloc(IMG_WIDTH * IMG_HEIGHT * sizeof(float));
>     for (int i = 0; i < width * height; i++) {
>         input[i] = (float)(image_data[i] / 255.0);
>     }
>
>     // Predict
>     int prediction = predict(input);
>
>     // Output prediction
>     printf("%d\n", prediction);
>
>     // Clean up
>     free(image_data);
>     free(input);
>     return 0;
> }
> EOF

> #include <stdlib.h>

> // Model parameters
> #define INPUT_DIM 784
> #define HIDDEN_DIM 128
> #define NUM_CLASSES 10
>
> // Model weights and biases as static arrays
> float input_weights[INPUT_DIM * HIDDEN_DIM];
> float input_bias[HIDDEN_DIM];
> float hidden_weights[HIDDEN_DIM * HIDDEN_DIM];
> float hidden_bias[HIDDEN_DIM];
> float output_weights[HIDDEN_DIM * NUM_CLASSES];
> float output_bias[NUM_CLASSES];
>
> // Image dimensions
> #define IMG_WIDTH 28
> #define IMG_HEIGHT 28
>
> // Load weights from JSON
> void load_weights(const char* filename) {
>     FILE* f = fopen(filename, "r");
>     if (!f) {
>         printf("Error: Cannot open weights file: %s\n", filename);
>         exit(1);
>     }
>     fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);

>         printf("Error: Could not read weights file\n");
>         free(data);
>         exit(1);

>     free(data);

>         printf("Error: Invalid JSON\n");
>         exit(1);
>     }
>     // Flatten weights in the order of input_layer.weight, input_layer.bias,
>     // hidden_layer.weight, hidden_layer.bias, output_layer.weight, output_layer.bias

>     // input_layer.bias

>     }

>     for (int i = 0; i < HIDDEN_DIM * HIDDEN_DIM; i++) {

>     // output_layer.bias

>     }

> }

> // Load and convert image to array of floats

>     return out;
> }

> // Function to compute activation

>     return (x > 0) ? x : 0;
> }

> // Function to compute forward pass

>     // hidden layer

>             max_val = output[i];
>             idx = i;
>         }
>     }
>     free(hidden);
>     free(output);
>     return idx;
> }
